brief:
Democracy for the Arab World Now filed formal sanctions referrals with the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Norway and Australia on Wednesday, calling for punitive measures against former and current Israeli army unit commanders overseeing what the organization describes as a starvation campaign against Palestinians in Gaza since October 7, 2023.

The referrals target commanders of the Israeli military unit administering the policy, according to DAWN. The organization alleges a systematic campaign of food deprivation targeting the civilian population in the Gaza Strip.
dek: (Washington, D.C., September 24, 2026) - The former and current commanders of the Israeli army unit administering and implementing Israel’s campaign of starvation against Palestinians in Gaza since October 7, 2023 should be sanctioned, said Democracy for the Arab World Now (DAWN) in filing formal sanctions referrals with the governments of the U.S., U.K., Canada, Norway and Australia today.
title: US allies urged to sanction Israeli commanders over Gaza starvation campaign
